events.name: Children’s Sensory Salt Room, Halo Health Banbridge
events.description: Private sensory-room-style salt room with lights, mirrors and toys; you never share unless you book with friends. Calm, one-family sessions.

events.name: Tír na nÓg Children’s Roleplay Centre, West Belfast
events.description: Child-sized town of themed shops and props for imaginative play, in timed limited-capacity sessions (9:30, 12:00, 14:30) Mon, Wed, Fri, Sat and Sun. Café.
events.venue: Tír na nÓg, Work West Enterprise Centre

events.name: Twig & Tumble play café, Enniskillen
events.description: Calm, nature-inspired play café with a plywood forest frame, open-ended toys and a quiet room. 90-minute booked sessions.

events.name: Mini Minds Play Café, Ballyclare
events.description: Cosy soft play and sensory play café for babies to preschoolers. Book online.

events.name: Bubbles Adventure Alley, Strabane
events.description: Indoor play café with soft play, climbing and slides in 75-minute bookable sessions. Open daily 10–6.

events.name: Adventure Village, Armagh
events.description: Indoor role-play village (vet surgery, castle, farm, space station) with soft play and a sensory room. 90-minute Stay & Play sessions; book ahead.

events.name: Nature & Nurture role play village, Lisburn Square
events.description: 11 play spaces including a mini market, GP surgery and a sensory room, plus a café. 90-minute sessions.

events.name: Sugar Plums Play Café, Newtownards
events.description: Calm play café for 0–5s in a listed building in Newtownards, with sensory classes coming soon.

events.name: Into the Woods soft play, Carryduff
events.description: Woodland-themed soft play with calm corners and imaginative play; sessions start every half hour 9:00–15:30.

events.name: Tiny Town role play, Drumahoe
events.description: Small-world role-play town (café, school, supermarket, hospital, farm, fire station) at 60 Church Brae, Drumahoe.

events.name: Streamvale Open Farm, Dundonald
events.description: Long-running open farm on the edge of Belfast with animal handling, feeding and play. Seasonal; check the site for event days.

events.name: Tayto Castle factory tour, Tandragee
events.description: 90-minute guided tour of the crisp factory in Tandragee Castle. Ages 5+ only; pre-book.

events.name: Duff Land soft play, Sixmilecross (Omagh)
events.description: Soft play and party centre in 90-minute play passes. Weekends 11–5 in term time, longer in holidays.

events.name: Pirates Adventure Golf, Dundonald
events.description: Two 18-hole pirate-themed outdoor mini-golf courses with cannons, waterfalls and a schooner, beside the Ice Bowl. Year-round; no booking.

events.name: Grangewater Open Farm, Desertmartin
events.description: Small family farm with animals to feed and pet, plus a playpark. Weekends.

events.name: Clip ’n Climb Dundonald
events.description: Colourful clip-in climbing walls at the Ice Bowl; check the minimum age.

events.name: World of Owls, Randalstown
events.description: Owl and bird-of-prey rescue centre in Randalstown Forest with flying displays.

events.name: Navan Centre & Fort, Armagh
events.description: Iron Age and Celtic heritage centre with a reconstructed roundhouse and Navan Fort mound.

events.name: Inflatable World, Cookstown
events.description: Indoor inflatable park in Cookstown. Book online.

events.name: Hunters Quest, Magherafelt
events.description: Indoor family play and adventure venue in Magherafelt.

events.name: Florence Court (National Trust), Fermanagh
events.description: Georgian house with big grounds, a walled garden, woodland walks and play for kids beneath Cuilcagh.

events.name: Castle Coole (National Trust), Enniskillen
events.description: Neoclassical mansion in parkland, with lakeside walks and family trails.

events.name: Crom Estate (National Trust), Newtownbutler
events.description: Lough Erne estate with woodland and lakeside walks, an old castle ruin and wildlife.

events.name: Springhill (National Trust), Moneymore
events.description: 17th-century plantation house with a costume collection, walled gardens and woodland walks.

events.name: The Argory (National Trust), Moy
events.description: Riverside Regency house with gardens and woodland and riverside walks.

events.name: Rowallane Garden (National Trust), Saintfield
events.description: Garden with woodland, a walled garden and a natural play trail.

events.name: Enniskillen Castle & Fermanagh County Museum
events.description: Lakeside castle housing Fermanagh County Museum and the Inniskillings Museum, with family activities.

events.name: Palace Demesne & Garden of the Senses, Armagh
events.description: Historic free park with a play area, woodland paths and a Garden of the Senses full of textures and scents.
events.venue: Palace Demesne & Garden of the Senses

events.name: Slieve Gullion Forest Park adventure playground & Giant’s Lair
events.description: Huge adventure playground (tower, tube slide, toddler area, zip line, maze) plus the Giant’s Lair storybook trail (just under a mile, some hills).
events.venue: Slieve Gullion Forest Park adventure playground & Giant’s Lair

events.name: Sensory Skate Session, The Rink Portadown
events.description: Sensory-friendly ice skating session for those who benefit from a sensory-controlled environment (ASD-friendly), every second Saturday of the month. Confirm the next date with The Rink.

events.name: Xtreme Jump Derry autism-friendly session
events.description: Trampoline park autism-friendly session on Sunday mornings (book ahead, grip socks needed). Times from directory listing; confirm with venue (028 7135 2111).

events.name: Bloomfield Shopping Centre Quiet Hour, Bangor
events.description: Weekly quiet hour: mall music off, lights dimmed where safe, many stores mute tills. JAM Card friendly.

events.name: St George's Market Quiet Hour, Belfast
events.description: Official quiet hours at the Victorian market: music switched off and noise reduced to support autistic visitors and families.

events.name: Tree House Soft Play SEN sessions, Lurgan
events.description: Quieter SEN soft play sessions: max 25 children, reduced noise and distractions, sensory toys and ear defenders available. Book in advance by phone/email.
events.venue: Tree House Soft Play, Quarry Business Park

events.name: The Playtrail inclusive play park (Liberty Consortium), near Eglinton
events.description: Inclusive outdoor play facility run by a disability charity: junior, adventure and sensory play areas, wheelchair-accessible roundabout and swings, sensory panels, 1km accessible trail and woodland walk.

events.name: Sleeping Beauty — autism-friendly performance, Craic Theatre
events.description: Autism-friendly (relaxed) performance of the Craic youth panto Sleeping Beauty (Blue group).

events.name: Wanes World soft play & sensory room, Dungiven
events.description: Play centre with big playframe, toddler area, trampolines and a separate sensory room (babies to 11).

events.name: Tiny Tornadoes soft play & role-play village, Banbridge
events.description: Indoor soft play with role-play village and café; runs quiet hours and Sensory Stations sessions (check Facebook for dates).
